# Cube fixture

`cube.planar_code` is the original labelled planar-code record from the local
plantri census. Its embedding-based canonical graph hash is
`204b8679f3d0425a4964c1b6574ada41a4aecc186316477cf33fa20be1b301ee`.
The fixture lets the benchmark test run from a fresh checkout without the
ignored local `results/` directory. Exact Hamiltonian and hsep certificates
are generated and independently checked by the test.
